name: mcrp-theme
description: MCRP Campus theme - front-end build (SCSS + JS).

scripts.build: npm run build:css && npm run build:js
scripts.build:css: sass --no-source-map --style=compressed assets/src/scss/main.scss assets/dist/main.css && sass --no-source-map --style=compressed assets/src/scss/editor.scss assets/dist/editor.css && postcss assets/dist/*.css --use autoprefixer --replace --no-map
